value.rationale: A newly proposed fourth-order dissipative solver on the canonical convex nonlinear gradient flow becomes an ambiguous three-valued numerical map at coarse steps. Its mathematically permitted branches have incompatible large-t states, including two sign reversals and exponentially slow motion. This motivates meaningful branch-selection/uniqueness safeguards; energy decay by itself does not address them.
